fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have been assigned to S1900K by the Southwest Oncology Group (SWOG) Statistics and Data Management Center (SDMC). Assignment to S1900K is determined by the LUNGMAP protocol
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Trial assignment via protocol-specific central methods is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have documentation of stage IV or recurrent NSCLC with a MET exon 14 skipping mutation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There is no specialized typed kind for MET exon 14 skipping mutations.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must have measurable disease documented by CT or MRI.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have other known actionable oncogenic alterations, such as (but not limited to) EGFR sensitizing mutations, EGFR T790M mutation, ALK gene fusion, ROS1 gene rearrangement, RET gene rearrangement, NTRK rearrangement, HER2 mutation, KRAS activating mutations, and BRAF V600E mutation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of multiple generalized actionable alterations goes beyond a single standard biomarker check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants must not have received any prior systemic therapy (systemic chemotherapy, immunotherapy or investigational drug) within 21 days prior to sub-study randomization
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior systemic therapy washout window with multiple alternative categories is not a standard typed drug exclusion.
